scope: Clean source working tree (excluding inherited Git metadata) and runtime, including compiled bytes and nested add-in archive; UTF-8/ASCII and UTF-16 paths, local identities, SID and credential patterns.
retained: Required public author/copyright credits, dependency notices, public upstream links, generic example paths and runtime-resolved installation paths.
notIncluded: Personal client configuration, raw logs, project data, screenshots, debug profiles/symbols, and Git metadata are excluded from distribution archives.
